leftEvidence.title: The fruit is taken and both eat

points.label: Language of breach
points.left: The serpent questions the command, the woman sees and takes the fruit, gives it to her husband with her, and both become aware of their nakedness.
points.right: Hosea says the people broke covenant like Adam and were unfaithful there.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:1–7
points.right: Adam in wisdom and reflection · later memory · Hosea 6:7

payload.posture: The husband and woman eat from the prohibited tree is held beside Hosea says the people broke covenant like Adam and were unfaithful there.

rightEvidence.title: Hosea compares covenant breach to Adam

payload.tension: Hosea names covenant breach and “there,” while Genesis narrates a crossed command in the garden.
payload.title: Adam and covenant breach in Hosea
